headline: ‘A despicable betrayal’: Democrats incensed by Haley Stevens’ endorsement of Mike Rogers

members.title: ‘A despicable betrayal’: Democrats incensed by Haley Stevens’ endorsement of Mike Rogers
members.lead: Stevens’s decision sparked fierce backlash from members of the party, while Donald Trump praised the sudden switch Democrat Haley Stevens’s shocking last-minute endorsement of Mike Rogers, the Michigan Republican Senate candidate, in the run-up to Tuesday’s midterm elections has sparked fierce backlash from members of her party. Stevens, who narrowly lost in the Democratic primary for Senate to Abdul El-Sayed, announced her support for Rogers after a feud with the El-Sayed campaign over an outside group’s advertisement, which blamed the high cost of living on US support for Israel. members.title: How Israel is at the heart of Haley Stevens’s extraordinary reversal
members.lead: The issue runs through almost every twist and turn and has come to define the congresswoman’s political persona For Haley Stevens, the road from Democratic Senate candidate to campaigning alongside a Republican she once called a rubber stamp for Donald Trump has been remarkably short – and the issue running through almost every twist and turn has been Israel. Having failed to stop Abdul El-Sayed in the primary, Stevens chose to back Republican Mike Rogers on Sunday, a candidate who she previously warned would enable Trump’s agenda – apparently because the Democrat who won refuses to share her position on Israel.
